title: Space Biscuits
tagline: Space Biscuits - to the moon and beyond
description: This project enables space fans to collect fresh imagery from space missions as soon as they happen. The project scans Space Tech sites to retrieve imagery which is then minted into an NFT and posted to IPFS for near eternal storage.
how_its_made: This project has been made using Chainlink to manage data retrieval and posting, with IPFS used for storage via a custom server and Unlock to manage fan access
